mapper.select: SELECT id,shop_id,event_key,event_type,payload,attempts FROM pdd_event_spool WHERE state='pending' AND available_at<=#{now} ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE pdd_event_spool SET state='delivered',delivered_at=#{now},error_code=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND state='pending'
UPDATE pdd_event_spool SET attempts=attempts+1,available_at=#{now},error_code=#{code} WHERE id=#{id} AND state='pending'
